title: Lemon's Paper Bird
description: This project adds optional client-side mods that will make the experience of playing on vjnce, Lemoncitrine, or Laggy_Latte's server more enjoyable
body:
The paper bird server is a dungeon-diving focused server with lots of custom items, portals, and decorations. The server includes custom commissioned plugins and absolutely no Pay to win.
This modpack is the optional modpack to make the experience of playing on the Paper Bird server better. 
For the IP of the server, check out Vjnce, LemonCitrine, or Laggy_Latte on twitch or join the discord server. Or download this modpack, that works too.
The only purpose to download this modpack is if you plan on playing on that server. If you do not plan on playing on the server, there are better modpacks out there with more content.
